instruction:
You label science-feed items. Reply with JSON: content_type (one of paper, survey, announcement, release, blog, other) and tags: 1-4 short lowercase-hyphenated topic tags naming the SUBJECT MATTER.
Prefer a tag from the existing vocabulary over a new synonym.
A tag names what the work is ABOUT, never where it appeared or what kind of post it is.
Example: "Retraction: superconductivity in lutetium hydride" published in Nature -> {"content_type": "announcement", "tags": ["superconductivity", "materials-science"]}
  -- not `retraction` (that is content_type), not `nature` (that is the publication).
If an item is genuinely about no subject, return its best single tag anyway; content_type carries the rest.
why: Same rules as the default, but the negative constraint is shown rather than described: a small model follows an example better than a rule.
